runs.label: cube Briggs orientation fix
runs.result: 6/6 cases pass products, counts and both selected scalars (driver exit 0). point-cube-briggs maxpsfsidelobe 0.04809781536459923 vs CASA 0.048097819089889526 (relative 7.7e-8); its .psf NRMS 9.82e-8 (was 1.04e-5) and .residual NRMS 2.50e-6 (was 1.05e-5). Every case's .pb NRMS is 0.0.

cube_briggs_diagnosis.method: CASA's per-row IMAGING_WEIGHT scratch table, captured by wrapping PySynthesisImager.makePSF around an unchanged casatasks.tclean (point-cube-briggs request, niter=0), against an evidence-only native dump of every (MAIN row, channel) imaging weight (patch evidence-weight-dump.patch, never committed).
cube_briggs_diagnosis.before_fix: 7 of 3,056,967 weights differ (channels 1, 4 twice, 6, 10, 12, 15; 0.2% to 32%); every other weight agrees to 1.4e-7. All 7 have a native Float u-cell coordinate exactly at k + 1/2.
cube_briggs_diagnosis.cause: Native evaluated the cube rule with u mirrored relative to BriggsCubeWeightor (which negates u and v, FTMachine::negateUV and u = -uvw*f). Mirrored grids agree for interior samples, but rounding half away from zero is not mirror-symmetric at an exact Float tie.
cube_briggs_diagnosis.rejected_hypothesis: Fused multiply-add contraction in CASA's arm64 build: a native mul_add experiment changed only one of the seven, and row 32452 shows CASA rounds the unfused tie.
cube_briggs_diagnosis.after_fix: 0 of 3,056,967 weights differ; worst relative difference per channel <= 1.35e-7.
cube_briggs_diagnosis.regression: crates/casa-imaging-operator/tests/weighting.rs a_float_tie_rounds_in_casas_orientation fails on the parent and passes at 2628d8b.
